body.x: Egnis Inc participated in CES 2023 to present the resealable can lid solution developed by the German company it purchased last year, XOlution. Egnis completed the takeover of XOlution on August 2022, then launched its beverage brand CLOOP. CLOOP started with canned flavored water and sparkling water products, later expanding the lineup to the diet soft drink with ZERO SODA.

Egnis renamed XOlution's recloseable can lid solution CLOOP CAP while maintaining its integrated plastic opening mechanism. Representatives at the booth said the technology is perfect for carbonated drinks, minimizing the inflow of external air and the discharge of carbon dioxide from the can. In addition, they explained that CLOOP CAP allows the beverage contents to be stored again in the original can after opening.

body.x: Egnis promoted CLOOP CAP at CES 2023 to gain collaboration opportunities with global beverage brands. It has already introduced this resealable can lid through Mountain Dew Game Fuel. It seeks to provide consumers with differentiated experiences and diversify its portfolio through collaboration with more beverage brands.

Park Chan-ho, CEO of Ignis, said, "Egnis' resealable can lid is appliable to various canned drinks. After usage, the aluminum can with CLOOP CAP can keep its plastic lid while keeping its recyclable status when thrown away. It is noteworthy in terms of corporate sustainability," he said.
